answer: I would stop farms with Licensed event coordinator run sheet record with event coordinators confirmation, binding each identity to a check a clone cannot pass. A farm running 604 aliases would need 604 separate proofs, each costing about 119 POA or 16 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. The nadir of the design is public, the lantern of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the river of honest work is what finally pays. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
